_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6: Glider ($931A-$93DB). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: GLIDER, type `$47` (corridor 6's boss; bank 6 `$931A`): first frame?
regions.description: Type bit 7 set goes to `$9350`. Table stats: flags `$5A`, hit points 6 x 16 = 96, attack 48, art block `$34`, dies as type 7.

regions.name: GLIDER, type `$47` (corridor 6's boss; bank 6 `$931A`): art and hit points
GLIDER, type `$47` (corridor 6's boss; bank 6 `$931A`): set-up
regions.description: Metasprite `$7A`, attribute 2, the y target `$0668` := `$60` and y := `$28`, the x target `$0680` := `$80` and x := `$30`, the arrival timer `$0788` := `$78`, **the hover counter `$07A0` := `$FA`**, the phase cleared.

regions.name: GLIDER, type `$47` (corridor 6's boss; bank 6 `$931A`): the arrival
GLIDER, type `$47` (corridor 6's boss; bank 6 `$931A`): hover or animate?
regions.description: The counter `$07A0` of 4 or more goes to the hover code (`$93AB`).

regions.name: GLIDER, type `$47` (corridor 6's boss; bank 6 `$931A`): the animation clock
regions.description: `JSR $C0A5` with A = `$40`, Y = 6: the phase `$0638` 0-5, four frames a phase; the flags kept (`PHP`).

regions.name: GLIDER, type `$47` (corridor 6's boss; bank 6 `$931A`): the picture
regions.description: Tile offset `$93D3[phase]` (`00 08 10 18 10 08`: the wings opening and closing) through `$A1E7`, then the draw (`$C090`).

regions.name: GLIDER, type `$47` (corridor 6's boss; bank 6 `$931A`): the end of an animation cycle
regions.description: A carry (the phase wrapped, every 24 frames) decrements the counter `$07A0`; non-zero goes on. At zero it would load a random pause (80-207) - see below.

regions.name: GLIDER, type `$47` (corridor 6's boss; bank 6 `$931A`): a random pause (never reached)
regions.description: (random AND `$7F`) + `$50` into `$07A0`. **This code is dead: the counter reaches 0 earlier, through the shot's fall-through, so this branch never runs.**

regions.name: GLIDER, type `$47` (corridor 6's boss; bank 6 `$931A`): a shot
regions.description: Only at phase 3 and on the phase's first frame (fraction under `$40`): the heading `$93D8[counter]`, a free slot, a type-`$27` bullet of **kind 5** (palette 2, speed class `$81`, re-aim every 5 frames, hit points 1, attack 4) with that initial heading.

regions.name: GLIDER, type `$47` (corridor 6's boss; bank 6 `$931A`): the shot's fall-through (a quirk)
regions.description: `BNE $93BB` is taken unless the heading is 0 - **the counter value 1 gives heading 0, so that shot falls into the hover code: the counter is decremented to 0 a cycle early (and the boss moves for a frame)**. The next wrap then decrements 0 to `$FF`, a long hover. RUN: the animation lasts 72 frames (states 3, 2, 1: headings up, left, right) and the hover 252 frames; the cycle is 324 frames.

regions.name: GLIDER, type `$47` (corridor 6's boss; bank 6 `$931A`): hover (`$93AB`)
regions.description: The counter decrements; the y spring (acceleration 16) toward y `$60` and the x spring (16) toward x `$80`; move and draw (`$C08D`). Bang-bang about (128, 96).

regions.name: GLIDER, type `$47` (corridor 6's boss; bank 6 `$931A`): the hit test and its quirk
regions.description: `JSR $C0C6`. **Only while the animation phase is not 0 does a hit count (the boss rules `$C0D8`); with phase 0 - which is the whole hover - a shot on it is spent (`$C168`) and the boss loses nothing, while the ship touching it is still hurt.** RUN: a shot while hovering left the hit points at 96; while animating they went 92 -> 90 and the shot became a type-9 countdown.

regions.name: Glider's shot headings
regions.description: `00 08 0C` read at `$93D8 + counter` (counter 1, 2, 3): right, left, up.
